purpose: Teach: シーア/難関/人民元/ウイグル/最高峰/浙江/広州/天空

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、シーア派関連のテロ警戒を、警察、強化されますね
lines.en: So this Shia-related terror threat—the police are stepping up their vigilance on this, aren't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful and measured. Lean forward slightly on the opening phrase. Genuine curiosity in the question—not challenging, seeking confirmation. Steady eye contact. Slight rise on the tag question at the end.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、難関事件の解決にもあたられますね
lines.en: Right, and they're handling these difficult cases too, aren't they?
lines.style: Warm agreement, like nodding along. Soft spoken but present. No hesitation. The affirmation of someone who knows the work and respects it. Steady, reliable tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、人民元偽札の流通を、警察、捜査されますね
lines.en: This counterfeit RMB circulation case—the police are investigating that, correct?
lines.style: Focused and careful with each detail. Slight pause between phrases, as if thinking it through while speaking. The tone of someone taking notes internally. Respectful attention without urgency.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、ウイグル難民支援者への嫌がらせ事案にも対応されますね
lines.en: And they're also responding to harassment cases against Uyghur support workers, aren't they?
lines.style: Steady recognition of a serious matter. The words land with quiet weight. No defensiveness, just clear acknowledgment. Tone carries a note of concern held close.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、最高峰登山中の事故救助を、警察、担当されますね
lines.en: This mountain rescue operation during a summit attempt—that's something the police are handling as well, yes?
lines.style: Slightly slower pace on the specifics. Gentle respect for the gravity of the situation. The questioning tone carries genuine interest in confirmation rather than doubt. Warm underlying attention.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、浙江省からの密入国者にも対応されますね
lines.en: They're also dealing with illegal migrants coming in from Zhejiang province, aren't they?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact statement wrapped as a question. No judgment in the delivery, just factual recognition. Steady, neither rushed nor slow. The tone of someone listing operational realities.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、広州への密輸事件を、警察、捜査されますね
lines.en: And this smuggling case involving Guangzhou—the police are investigating that too, aren't they?
lines.style: Continued measured tone, building a sense of scope. The question feels like one more confirmation in a longer list. No fatigue, just patient accumulation of details. Clear and direct.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、天空監視ドローンを活用されますね
lines.en: They're making use of those aerial surveillance drones now, aren't they?
lines.style: Tone brightens slightly—this feels like a shift toward capability and solution. Less questioning, more acknowledging a positive development. Conversational and direct, as if noting an innovation.
